summary.text: Jourdan Deitz is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 48, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Mackenzie Holdren for a seat with no incumbent.
According to Ballotpedia, she served in the U.S. Coast Guard from 2015 to 2024 and works in construction.

paragraphs.text: Jourdan Deitz graduated from Richwoods High School and, according to Ballotpedia, earned a bachelor's degree from Shepherd University in 2011.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a born and raised West Virginian.
Deitz was unopposed in the May 12, 2026 Democratic primary.
In the survey, she said she wants to hear from West Virginians about their needs, support growth and opportunity, and help grow the economy.
She named societal issues, infrastructure development and redistributive policies as the areas of public policy she is most passionate about.
